main_text.p: stratum consistit primo in defendenda, amplí-ficanda, excellentia, atque authoritate Magi-stratus; & cura, ne illa contemnatur, vel vilescat. 1. Sam. cap. 16. 7. 8. 9. Tum dicente Abischaio filio Tzeruia regi, quare malediceret canis iste mortuus domino meo regi? Transeam quaeso, vt auferam caput eius. 1. Sam. cap. 11. 12. Tum dixit populus Samueli, Quis est qui dicebat, Saul ne regnaret super nos? date ipsos homines vt mortí tradamus eos. Act. c. 23. 4. 5. Iudic. cap. 1. 8. Exemplum extat 1. Sam. cap. 10. 26. 27. cap. 11. 12. 13. 2. Sam. cap. 15. 35. 36. cap. 19. 29. 30. 31. 32. 33. & vers. 7. 8. Petr. Gregor. lib. 8. cap. 3. de Repub.

Secundo consistit etiam in prosperitate, sa-lute & commodo Magistratus promouendo & quaerendo. Ierem. c. 9. 7. Baruch. cap. 1. 11. 12. 2. Reg. c. 5. 13. 14. & seqq. 2. Sam. cap. 17. 18. & seqq. cap. 21. 17. 18. cap. 18. 3. 4. 5. c. 19. 6. 7. 8. 9. cap. 15. 27. 28. & seqq. c. 16. ita vt salutem & commodum Magistratus proprio anteponat. 2. Sam. c. 19. 31. Dixit vero Mephiboseth Regi, vel omnia accipiat, postquam venit Dominus meus rex cum pace domum suam, c. 15. 21. Respondens vero Ithai regi dixit, vt viuit Iehoua & viuit Dominus meus Rex, tantum modo in loco vbi erit Dominus meus rex, siue ad mortem siue ad vitam, ibi futurus est seruus tuus. & 1. Sam. cap. 16. 15. 16. 17. 2. Sam. c. 18. 3. 4. c. 21. 17. 2. Sam. c. 2. 24. 20. & seqq. c. 1. 14. 16. Genef. c. 45. 9. 10. 11. & sustenta-bo te ibi, ne pauperiate consumaris tu & familia tua, & omnia quae sunt tibi: & 1. Chronic. c. 12. 39. Hi fue-runt cum Dauide tribus diebus, comedentes & bibentes, quia praparauerant eis fratres eorum. 40. Atque etiam propinqui ipsorum ab Issachare & Zebulone & Na-

page.notes: The running head is probably "CAP. V." with a page number 162; the printed head reads "Cap. V." in spaced capitals. Several words are uncertain in the scan, notably the Hebrew-named forms and the italic citations; the page ends mid-word with "Na-", which continues on the next page. Show-through from the reverse side and the edge at the right are not transcribed.
